args.title: Halvorsen Supply — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Halvorsen Supply’s latest newsletter highlights freight pricing this quarter and points readers to its main analysis, with a companion page available as a fallback.
- The analysis reports that spot freight rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- The companion piece finds that shippers splitting volume across three carriers paid the least.
